name: Deepika Dash

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Deepika Dash’s Odia poems in Kabita Live move between intimate longing and the desire for freedom. In ‘ଲଜ୍ଜାଶୀଳା_ରୂପବତୀ’, moonlight, flowers, the sea and wandering wind seem to borrow their beauty and movement from the beloved. The landscape becomes a language for tenderness.

Her later poems shift the scale from a solitary star to a bird released from its cage. In ‘ଏକଲା_ତାରାର_ଲୁହ’, an apparent ending leaves behind a hopeful question; in ‘କେଡ଼େ କ୍ଷୁଦ୍ର ବ୍ରହ୍ମାଣ୍ଡ’, flight changes the bird’s sense of the world. These poems give small, vulnerable figures the power to imagine beyond their limits.
